verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud deployment platform, so incremental rollout is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never documents canary, percentage-based, or progressive rollouts. Instant rollback, replicas with load balancing, and per-PR preview environments are related features that reduce risk, but none of them shifts traffic to a new deployment gradually, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
